title: Release Cadence Gap Alert
dataSources: GitHub repositories (`github:repo`), commits (`github:commit`), issues (`github:issue`), and releases (`github:release`).
app: GitHub repository metadata, commit activity feeds, issue trackers, and release publish logs forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=github:release repo_name=* tag_name=*
| sort repo_name - _time
| streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_release by repo_name
| eval gap_days=round((_time-prev_release)/86400,0)
| where gap_days>90
| table repo_name tag_name gap_days
description: Detects repositories whose latest release is more than ninety days after the previous one.
value: Release cadence gaps on public side projects signal bitrot for dependents waiting on fixes.
implementation: Log each GitHub release with `repo_name` and compare inter-release gaps against your target schedule.
visualization: Table of repos with days between releases.
grandmaExplanation: It counts projects where you have not shipped a release in three months or more.
